tours.title: Make a sprite talk
tours.description: Give your sprite a speech bubble.

steps.title: Say something
steps.text: This block shows a speech bubble for a few seconds. Type your own words in the box.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “say Hello! for 2 seconds” under it, then click your sprite.

waitFor.label: Drag the “say” block under the hat block

steps.title: Keep saying
steps.text: This one keeps its bubble up until you say something else, or say nothing to clear it. “think” works the same way.

steps.title: Next costume
steps.text: Most sprites have several costumes. This block switches to the next one.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “next costume” under it, then click your sprite a few times to see it change.

waitFor.label: Drag the “next costume” block under the hat block

steps.title: Pick a costume
steps.text: Or choose exactly which costume to show from the menu. Use this together with “wait” blocks to make an animation.

tours.title: Grow, shrink and hide
tours.description: Change how big your sprite is, or hide it.

steps.title: Change size
steps.text: This block makes your sprite bigger or smaller. A positive number grows it, and a negative number shrinks it.

steps.title: Try it yourself!
steps.text: I've added a “when this sprite clicked” block to your code area. Drag “change size by 10” under it, then click your sprite again and again.

waitFor.label: Drag the “change size” block under the hat block

steps.title: Hide
steps.text: This block makes your sprite disappear. Try it on its own, then bring your sprite back with “show”.
